provenance.source: Owned synthetic constant, gradient, and deterministic random pixels; no external image content.
provenance.encoder: Pillow 12.3.0 / libwebp 1.6.0; FFmpeg libvpx for 1/2/4/8 coefficient partitions
provenance.oracle: FFmpeg VP8 decoder, YUV420 planes. Expected RGBA uses nearest-neighbor chroma and integer limited-range BT.601 conversion, not libwebp fancy upsampling.
